navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, fixed 64px height, 2px brand-red bottom border; app icon (warehouse.png) + 'StockFlow' title left, nav links right; active link uses brand-red. Tap targets >=44x44px.

page.notes: warm-oat (--surface-page) background, centered ~960px content column; page__header holds the page title with the app icon beside the name; single content column on detail/form pages, grid on index pages.

card.notes: pure white surface on warm background, soft navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --radius-md; hosts the stock table and detail panels, --space-5 padding.

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, SHARP 0px corners, primary/active only e.g. Receive/Pick/Save), btn--secondary (outlined), btn--ghost (text-only). All >=44x44px, keyboard-reachable.

form_input.notes: persistent visible label (never placeholder-only), --radius-sm, clear focus ring (--color-info); validation problem shown inline next to the field, naming the field, via field__error with role=alert.

table.notes: calm high-contrast stock-by-location table; cool uppercase header row; quantity cells right-aligned in --font-mono with tabular-nums so numeric columns align.

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (success), badge--low (warning + 'low' text), badge--out (error + 'out' text), badge--on-order (info), badge--quarantined (navy). Pill (--radius-pill), --text-xs uppercase; meaning carried by BOTH text and color/shape, never color alone.
status_badge.notes: five stock-state pills: in-stock / low / out / on-order / quarantined.

empty_state.notes: line-style icon + teaching heading + guiding copy + a CTA (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); a SKU with no batch/serial detail shows a clear 'not tracked'. Never a blank region.

toast.notes: fixed top-right; feedback never shifts page layout; role=alert / aria-live. Failed barcode scan flashes scan zone red and shows a persistent error toast.

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input on the warehouse floor; a successful scan flashes green and updates the stock row in place, an unknown/locked scan flashes red and raises a persistent error toast.
